sub.zh: 一条记录从你嘴里到能召回，走这四步。
sub.en: Four steps from something you said to something you can recall.

1b.zh: 自然语言进来，不用先想该放哪个文件夹。
1b.en: Plain language in — no deciding which folder it belongs to first.

2b.zh: 认得清就直接往下走；认不清最多追问两轮，也可以跳过。
2b.en: Clear enough, it just proceeds; unclear, at most two quick follow-ups you can skip.

3b.zh: 落下来还能改：改文字、换类型都算数。
3b.en: Still yours to fix afterwards: change the text, change the type.

4b.zh: 有把握的直接整理好，拿不准的先问你；之后随时能改写、能撤回。
4b.en: Confident ones get filed right away, unsure ones ask first — and every one stays editable and revocable.
